## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 412 captures during May 2023. Activity proceeded in line with the planned programme, with session lists managed as expected. The service maintained routine operational arrangements throughout the reporting period. The only variation noted was routine leave, which was accommodated without affecting the overall delivery of scheduled activity.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 70 ungradable capture sets. This represented an ungradable rate of 17.0 of captures. The result indicates that a proportion of images could not be assessed reliably and should remain a focus for routine quality monitoring. Staff should continue to apply the established capture and image-quality procedures during sessions.

## Grading

Grading identified 101 referable results from the completed captures. These results were passed through the relevant review process in accordance with usual arrangements. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. Overall, grading activity was completed within the expected operational timeframe, while the ungradable findings provide an opportunity to reinforce image acquisition practice and support consistent assessment across future sessions.
